entry: Signal: the stock closes below the lower Bollinger Band (20, 2.5) while above its 200-day SMA.
Place a buy limit 3% below the last close, valid for one day only.
exit: Sell at the next open after the 2-day RSI closes above 50.
Time stop: if not exited, sell at the open of day 11 (the fill day counts as day 1).
stop_loss: No price stop, only the time stop.
filters: When there are too many signals, rank by 100-day rate of change, strongest first.
20% of capital per stock, at most 5 positions.
